office: Business Licensing Office, Office of the City Clerk, City of Port Alder

renewal_rules.cycle: Annual; every licence expires one year after issue (or on the date printed on it).
renewal_rules.reinstatement: A licence expired for more than 90 days is cancelled; the business must file a new application and pay the full new-application fee.

license_types.name: General Business Licence
requirements: National Business Registry number (BRN) from the business registry agency
Tax identification number
Zoning clearance for the business address (issued at the Permit Center, free)
Certificate of occupancy for commercial premises, or Home Occupation Permit for home-based businesses
Owner or officer photo ID
license_types.notes: Required for every business operating in Port Alder, including home-based and online businesses with a local address.

license_types.name: Food Service Establishment Permit
requirements: Active General Business Licence
Plan review approval for kitchen layout (new or remodelled kitchens)
Certified Food Protection Manager certificate for at least one manager on every shift
Pre-opening health inspection (booked after plan approval)
Grease interceptor maintenance contract
license_types.notes: Seating capacity determines the seat fee: $95 for each started block of 50 seats.

license_types.name: Mobile Food Vendor Permit
requirements: Active General Business Licence
Commissary agreement (signed letter from a licensed commissary kitchen)
Vehicle registration and commercial auto insurance ($500,000 minimum)
Certified Food Protection Manager certificate
Route and location plan (no vending within 30 m of a restaurant entrance or 150 m of a school during school hours)
Propane system certificate if cooking with gas
license_types.notes: Vending in city parks needs a separate Parks concession permit.

license_types.name: Short-Term Rental Operator Registration
requirements: Proof the unit is the operator's primary residence (two of: national ID address, voter registration, tax filing)
Life-safety self-inspection checklist (smoke and CO alarms, extinguisher, egress)
Liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 covering short-term rental use
Local contact available 24/7 within 30 minutes
Transient occupancy tax account (12% of nightly rate)
license_types.notes: Maximum 120 unhosted nights per year; registration number must appear on every listing.

license_types.name: Home Occupation Permit
requirements: Owner or landlord consent
Floor area used for the business no more than 25% of the home
No more than 8 customer visits per day and no signage larger than 0.2 square metres
license_types.notes: Required in addition to the General Business Licence for businesses run from a residence.

license_types.name: Contractor Registration
requirements: National trade licence for the trade (building, electrical, plumbing, roofing...)
General liability insurance of at least $500,000
Contractor bond of $10,000
Workers' compensation coverage if any employees
license_types.notes: Needed to pull building permits in Port Alder.

license_types.name: Livery Driver Permit (taxi and app-based ride services)
requirements: Valid national driving licence held for 3+ years
Background check (issued within 60 days)
Driving record with no more than 3 moving violations in 3 years
Medical fitness certificate
license_types.notes: Professional permit renewed every year; vehicles need a separate livery vehicle inspection.

license_types.name: Alcohol Beverage Service Endorsement
requirements: Active Food Service Establishment Permit
National alcohol licence
Responsible beverage service training for all servers within 60 days of hire
Public notice posted 14 days
license_types.notes: Neighbours may object during the 14-day notice period.
